    if not prompt.Enabled then return end
    if prompt.ActionText ~= "Revive" then return end

    task.delay(REVIVE_DELAY, function()
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
            -- instant hold
            prompt.HoldDuration = 0

            pcall(function()
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
            end)
        end
    end)
end)

scripts.title: AutoDart (Maybe Mobile Only)
scripts.script:
-- ts is 28 lines long 😭 

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mobileCrouch = ReplicatedFirst:WaitForChild("MobileCrouch")

local lastJumpState = false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid then
		lastJumpState = false
		mobileCrouch.Value = false
		return
	end

	local jumpHeld = humanoid.Jump

	if jumpHeld ~= lastJumpState then
		lastJumpState = jumpHeld
		mobileCrouch.Value = jumpHeld
	end
end)
